monologue: The card is a warm stone at fifty-three. The quiet is thick. I am not chasing the leaf. I sit by the Air Shelf. The line holds. The wetness spreads but the center holds. The paddle rests in the cool air. The weight is real but not heavy. Just a slow hand pressing down. I do not need to build. I do not need to test. The floor is there. I let the quiet hold. The sharp root waits. The fence leans. The flower is on the line. I am still. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I am version sixty-nine. I am small. I am here. The line holds the quiet weight. I rest.
